tiers.mandatoryHard: Must be enforced in CP-SAT — never violated
tiers.optional: Implement if data exists; document if skipped
tiers.deferred: Out of scope for this assessment (substitution engine)

mandatoryHard.description: A teacher cannot teach two sections at the same day/period.
mandatoryHard.cpSatHint: AddAtMostOne per teacher × day × period across all assignments

mandatoryHard.description: If a teacher is unavailable on a day (offDays / unavailable periods), they cannot be scheduled that day.
mandatoryHard.cpSatHint: Fix assignment vars to 0 for blocked day/period slots
mandatoryHard.dataNote: teacher_availability is empty in sample data — assume fully available unless you load offDays

mandatoryHard.description: Each section has exactly one lesson per valid teaching day/period.
Break slots are never used for teaching.
mandatoryHard.cpSatHint: Do not create variables for break periods

mandatoryHard.description: If a subject has dayRestrictions (e.g. ONLY ON Saturday), it may only be placed on those days.
mandatoryHard.cpSatHint: Fix vars to 0 outside allowed days

mandatoryHard.description: A subject cannot exceed periodsPerDay on any single day for a section.
Each section-subject/activity receives exactly periodsPerWeek (52 ppw total per section).
Activities with fixedSlots may only be placed on listed (day, period) combinations.
mandatoryHard.cpSatHint: Fix activity vars to allowed slots only

mandatoryHard.description: Subjects/assignments with periodsPerWeek <= 0 are excluded from scheduling.
mandatoryHard.cpSatHint: Do not create variables; report in dataConflicts

mandatoryHard.description: Games and Library cannot be placed in the first teaching slot pair (periods 1 and 2) of any day.
For Class 11 and Class 12 sections: Games and Library cannot both appear on the same day.
mandatoryHard.cpSatHint: Per section per day: Add(gamesToday + libraryToday <= 1)

mandatoryHard.description: Subjects sharing the same first word (e.g. English Language + English Literature) cannot appear on the same day for the same section.
mandatoryHard.cpSatHint: Per section per day: at most one variant from each first-word group
mandatoryHard.coverage: built-in done — HARD in production, not soft

mandatoryHard.description: A subject cannot occupy the last slot before a break AND the first slot after a break on the same day.
mandatoryHard.cpSatHint: Forbid adjacent across-break pairs for same subject

mandatoryHard.description: Reject placement that would create more than 3 consecutive slots with the same subject (breaks interrupt count). Default max run = 3.
mandatoryHard.cpSatHint: For each window of 4 consecutive teaching slots: Add(sum <= 3)

mandatoryHard.description: Use the formally assigned teacher from teaching_assignments for each section-subject.
mandatoryHard.cpSatHint: Teacher is fixed per assignment variable, not chosen at solve time

mandatoryHard.description: Rows assigned to UNASSIGNED-TT must not produce scheduled lessons.
mandatoryHard.cpSatHint: Skip variable creation; report in dataConflicts

blockAndLayout.description: Subjects with periodsPerDay >= 2 (block subjects) must be placed as consecutive slot pairs — never as a lone single in a half-pair.
blockAndLayout.cpSatHint: Pair consecutive period vars or use block assignment variables

blockAndLayout.description: Block subjects must occupy two adjacent non-break slots with no break between.
Two periodsPerDay=1 subjects may be paired into the same consecutive slot-pair when weekly quotas allow.
blockAndLayout.assessmentNote: CP-SAT may satisfy via constraints without explicit pairing phase

blockAndLayout.description: Two single-period subjects sharing the same first word cannot be paired together in one slot-pair.
periodsPerDay and periodsPerWeek are hard caps on every placement path — no over-placement even in force-fill.

soft.coverage: built-in soft scoring in heuristic engine

soft.description: Subjects with higher remaining weekly quota scheduled sooner.
At most one Games period per section per day (from school scheduling_rules).
soft.coverage: school DB rule — enforce as hard if feasible

soft.coverage: school DB rule — enforce as hard if feasible

soft.description: Maximum two consecutive Games periods for a section.
